svg.title: Gap map: songnodes backend
svg.desc: 11 gaps drawn as red dashed edges between the parts they affect, each badge numbered G1… and its contract listed below; proposed modules are dashed brand cards linked to the gaps they close.

g.aria-label: G14 Make API token usable by scripts and TIDAL routes – contract: X-API-Token header is the only admin credential; Authorization is reserved for provider tokens. (severity critical, effort S)
g.title: G14 Make API token usable by scripts and TIDAL routes – contract: X-API-Token header is the only admin credential; Authorization is reserved for provider tokens. (severity critical, effort S)

g.aria-label: G16 Working backup for the compose volume – contract: Backup file: backups/songnodes-YYYYMMDD.dump (pg custom format). (severity high, effort S)
g.title: G16 Working backup for the compose volume – contract: Backup file: backups/songnodes-YYYYMMDD.dump (pg custom format). (severity high, effort S)

g.aria-label: G20 Frontend calls routes that do not exist – contract: Use existing target-tracks router. (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G20 Frontend calls routes that do not exist – contract: Use existing target-tracks router. (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G18 Enforce the library ingest body contract – contract: Idempotency-Key + payload hash. (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G18 Enforce the library ingest body contract – contract: Idempotency-Key + payload hash. (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G15 Project library_track events into projection_tracks – contract: Outbox event registry: event_type -> consumers (projection_tracks, graph_projection). (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G15 Project library_track events into projection_tracks – contract: Outbox event registry: event_type -> consumers (projection_tracks, graph_projection). (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G13 Decide and document the real layer model – contract: Layer contract table: layer -> table -> sole writer -> readers. (severity high, effort S)
g.title: G13 Decide and document the real layer model – contract: Layer contract table: layer -> table -> sole writer -> readers. (severity high, effort S)

g.aria-label: G17 Single migration runner with a ledger – contract: schema_migrations(version, checksum, applied_at). (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G17 Single migration runner with a ledger – contract: schema_migrations(version, checksum, applied_at). (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G19 Music search has no deployed backend – contract: GET /api/v1/music-search/{service}?q= -> [{id, artist, title, isrc}]. (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G19 Music search has no deployed backend – contract: GET /api/v1/music-search/{service}?q= -> [{id, artist, title, isrc}]. (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G12 Run the scrape HTTP call outside the job transaction – contract: Handler contract: (prepare outside tx) -> (commit inside tx). (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G12 Run the scrape HTTP call outside the job transaction – contract: Handler contract: (prepare outside tx) -> (commit inside tx). (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G10 Scraper must stop at bronze – contract: Scraper output = bronze_scraped_playlists + bronze_scraped_tracks with positions 1..n; silver is written only by common/datalayer/ingest.py inside a transaction that appends an outbox event. (severity high, effort S)
g.title: G10 Scraper must stop at bronze – contract: Scraper output = bronze_scraped_playlists + bronze_scraped_tracks with positions 1..n; silver is written only by common/datalayer/ingest.py inside a transaction that appends an outbox event. (severity high, effort S)

g.aria-label: G11 Target scrapes must bypass the daily discovery quota – contract: POST /scrape response gains close_reason; handler treats daily_quota_reached as RetryableError. (severity high, effort S)
g.title: G11 Target scrapes must bypass the daily discovery quota – contract: POST /scrape response gains close_reason; handler treats daily_quota_reached as RetryableError. (severity high, effort S)

g.aria-label: M3 Transition feed (proposed module): Publishes `songnodes.transitions/1` (pairs of ISRCs with counts) beside library.json so both Set Builders can rank spares by proven pairings.
g.title: M3 Transition feed (proposed module): Publishes `songnodes.transitions/1` (pairs of ISRCs with counts) beside library.json so both Set Builders can rank spares by proven pairings.

g.aria-label: M4 Contract check (proposed module): Validates every cross-project file and request body against its schema in CI and in the weekly run, and fails with the field that broke.
g.title: M4 Contract check (proposed module): Validates every cross-project file and request body against its schema in CI and in the weekly run, and fails with the field that broke.

g.aria-label: G16 contract: Backup file: backups/songnodes-YYYYMMDD.dump (pg custom format).
g.title: G16 contract: Backup file: backups/songnodes-YYYYMMDD.dump (pg custom format).

g.aria-label: G20 contract: Use existing target-tracks router.
g.title: G20 contract: Use existing target-tracks router.

g.aria-label: G15 contract: Outbox event registry: event_type -> consumers (projection_tracks, graph_projection).
g.title: G15 contract: Outbox event registry: event_type -> consumers (projection_tracks, graph_projection).

g.text: Scraper output = bronze_scraped_playlists + bronze_scraped_tracks with positions 1..n; silver is
written only by common/datalayer/ingest.py inside a transaction that appends an outbox event.…
POST /scrape response gains close_reason; handler treats daily_quota_reached as RetryableError.
Handler contract: (prepare outside tx) -> (commit inside tx). (medium)
Layer contract table: layer -> table -> sole writer -> readers. (high)
X-API-Token header is the only admin credential; Authorization is reserved for provider tokens.
Outbox event registry: event_type -> consumers (projection_tracks, graph_projection). (medium)
